findings.message: Criterion 1 requires the size-0 and size-1 runs to record exactly the expected values written out in the test: the full `llm_call` keyword arguments, the `begin_watch` arguments and the returned `RequisitionVerdict`. `test_single` checks only `(run_seq, call_seq)` pairs, the spool names, verdict/calls and the watch count. A regression in the other `llm_call` keywords (ticket, stem, attempt, the request surface) or in the `begin_watch` arguments on the unchanged path would pass this test.
findings.paved_road: Assert the full recorded `llm_call` kwargs (excluding only the opaque effects/llm/redactor objects, or compare them to the stand-ins), the full `begin_watch` kwargs dict, and the stage_start/stage_end event payloads as exact expected values.

findings.message: Criterion 4 requires the `panel_facts` event of the snag/approve case to equal the worked example exactly. The test checks only member_count, verdict_counts, agreement_kind, merged agreement/members and dropped. It never checks `combiner == "findings-union"`, `kept_index is None`, the `members` entries, or the event_context fields (`stem`, `attempt`, `run_seq`, `surface="requisition_review"`) that the ticket says the event carries.
findings.paved_road: Compare the whole `panel_facts` kwargs dict against an exact expected dict built from the worked example, including combiner, kept_index, members and the stem/attempt/run_seq/surface context.
